basic_details.job_title: IIT Gandhinagar Project Assistant I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Center for Creative Learning at the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (IIT Gandhinagar) needs 1 Project Assistant I for its project 30-30 Eklavya 2024-26. The appointment is for 1 year, with a consolidated pay of Rs 28,000 to 53,000 per month depending on qualification and experience. The essential qualification is a B.C.A/B.Sc. or equivalent qualification in an appropriate discipline. Applications are made online through the IIT Gandhinagar project staff recruitment portal, and the last date is 2 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Project Assistant I Job Description
content_sections.text: According to the notice, the Project Assistant I will support the development of innovative STEM educational tools, embedded systems, robotics projects and experiential learning resources. The key responsibilities are: Design and develop embedded system prototypes using Arduino, Raspberry Pi, and similar platforms. Develop educational automation and robotics projects for schools and teacher training programmes. Assist in programming, testing, debugging, and documentation of hardware and software solutions. Support development of STEM kits, interactive learning modules, and workshop materials. Participate in field implementation, demonstrations, and training programmes across India. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams on educational innovation projects.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Assistant I post?
faq.answer: Apply online through the IIT Gandhinagar project staff recruitment portal (recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff) by 2 November 2026.
